people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: After a little while someone else saw him, and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”
translations.bsb: A short time later, someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.” But Peter said, “Man, I am not.”
translations.kjv: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
translations.asv: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou also art one of them. But Peter said, Man, I am not.
